mapper.sql: user_id, available, frozen, total_consumed, total_recharged, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `credit_account` WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `credit_account` (user_id, available, frozen, total_consumed, total_recharged, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{available}, #{frozen}, #{totalConsumed}, #{totalRecharged}, IFNULL(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))
mapper.update: UPDATE `credit_account` SET available = available + #{amount}, total_recharged = total_recharged + GREATEST(#{amount}, 0) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
